The '''Ancient Temple''' was a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] located on [[Nathema]] that was abandoned when the planet was [[Ritual of Nathema|devastated]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]]. The temple was later used by Vitiate to [[Emperor's Vaults|store]] the [[Zildrog]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. The weapon was eventually discovered by the [[Order of Zildrog]] after the death of Vitiate but was [[Mission to Nathema (Zildrog)|neutralized]] by the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR:TNC" />
